queue.pageDescription: Dense manager: HTTP and yt-dlp jobs, live progress, pause/resume for HTTP, bulk URLs, and reorder.
queue.reorderHint: Drag rows to set run order (queue_order). Save to apply.
queue.empty: No jobs yet. Start downloads from the dashboard or paste URLs above.
queue.selectHint: Select a row to see details and actions.

dashboard.pageDescription: Monitor downloads, storage, and Telegram delivery.

newDownload.title: New download
newDownload.description: Paste a link from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or almost anywhere else. We detect the source, show the choices that actually apply, and you can watch progress update in real time.
newDownload.placeholder: Paste a video, playlist, or file link here
newDownload.analyzeFailedHint: You can still try Download — defaults will be used.
newDownload.hintImage: No format or quality choices for this type — we download it as offered.
newDownload.hintGeneric: This page is not treated as streamable video — we use a simple default download.
newDownload.emptyHint: Paste a URL above to see a preview and available options.

health.successHint: Share of finished jobs that completed vs failed, per day sparkline.
health.diskHint: Whole partition hosting your media folder. Amber over 80% full, red over 95%.

heatmap.title: Download activity
heatmap.empty: No completed downloads in this range yet.

donut.title: By platform
donut.dualDescription: Inner ring = file count · outer ring = bytes

speed.title: Download speed distribution
speed.description: Completed jobs in the last 30 days (approx. speed at finish)
speed.empty: No speed samples yet — speeds are recorded on new completions.

active.title: Active downloads
active.empty: No active jobs. Start a download above.

history.cardDescription: Retry, delete, or send completed jobs to Telegram.
history.pageDescription: Browse completed and past download jobs.

bulkAdd.pageDescription: Paste up to 50 URLs (one per line) and queue them with the same format, quality, and HTTP connection count.
bulkAdd.cardDescription: Uses the same engine selection as the dashboard (yt-dlp, HTTP, playlists).
bulkAdd.truncated: Only the first 50 URLs were submitted.

analyzePage.pageDescription: Probe a URL before queuing — platform, media type, and playlist hints without starting a download.
analyzePage.cardDescription: Runs the same analysis as the dashboard new-download form.
analyzePage.notOk: The server returned a response but marked the link as not OK.

jobDetail.invalidId: This job link is not valid.
jobDetail.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted or you may not have access.

playlists.pageDescription: Browse playlist parent jobs and their per-item child downloads.
playlists.parentsDescription: Jobs that expanded into multiple queue entries.
playlists.selectParent: Select a playlist on the left.
playlists.emptyParents: No playlist jobs yet. Paste a playlist URL from the dashboard or bulk add.
playlists.emptyChildren: No child jobs for this playlist (yet).

storage.pageDescription: Files on disk and usage totals.
storage.summaryDescription: Space used and file count across your library.
storage.filesDescription: Manage stored paths — scroll sideways on small screens.

settings.telegramCardDescription: The project owner configures the bot token (encrypted at rest). Each user sets their own receiver channel or contact. Max upload via Bot API is 50 MB.
settings.telegramBotTokenOwnerHint: Only the project owner can change the bot token.
settings.telegramBotNotConfigured: The owner has not configured the bot token yet. Telegram delivery will not work until they do.
settings.telegramEnabledHint: Allow Telegram actions from this app.
settings.telegramAutoSendHint: Send each completed download to Telegram automatically.
settings.accountCardDescription: Display name, download defaults, storage retention, and password.
settings.retentionDescription: Completed downloads older than this are removed from disk only; history rows stay. Use 0 to keep files until you delete them.

auth.signInDescription: Use your account email and password.
